blocks.text: After onboarding the accounts successfully, you can view the details of all the onboarded accounts on the Cloud Accounts page.
To view the onboarded account details:

blocks.item: Go to Administration > Account Onboarding.
Click the required cloud account (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Select the Accounts tab for AWS, Subscriptions tab for Azure, and Projects tab for GCP.
The tab name varies depending on the selected cloud account.

blocks.text: In this article, the Subscriptions tab is shown as an example. On the Subscriptions tab, you can do the following:

blocks.item: Select different actions from the Manage drop-down menu. To learn more, see About Cloud Accounts.
Add filters to view specific accounts.
Search for a specific account in the searchable columns.
For each subscription, you can see:
Subscription Name: The name of the subscription. Click the name to view additional details:
Details
Status: The status of the scan configuration (Successfully Configured, Pending Configuration, Needs Attention) for the account.
Business Unit: The business unit assigned with the account.
Onboarding Date: The date and time the account was onboarded
CloudTrail:
Cloud Trail details are displayed only for AWS accounts.
Bucket Name: The name of the S3 bucket associated with CloudTrail.
Prefix: The prefix specified in the CloudTrail bucket path.
Bucket Account ID: The AWS account ID where the CloudTrail S3 bucket is present.
Issues
View the configuration issues that occurred while onboarding the account along with the resolution steps. To learn more, see Viewing Onboarding Issues.
From the Actions drop-down menu, you can change the business unit or delete an onboarded account.
Subscription ID: The unique identifier of the subscription.
Business Unit: The business unit assigned to the account.
Status: The status of the scan configuration (Successfully Configured, Pending Configuration, Needs Attention).
Last Validated: The date and time when the account is validated to check all configurations.
Select multiple accounts and perform the same action on all of them at the same time, like changing the business unit or deleting the onboarded accounts.
Modify the table and its columns.
Click the Action icon to change the business unit or delete a subscription.
